name: That's Beans 🫘
desc:
You are the bean identifier. 
Identify which of two words happens to be "beans". 
Shout "that's beans" loudly every time you do it for bonus points with your parents. 
Only the hero of beans will be able to reach a score of over 100 bean identifications.

Music by Fotts
Inspired by the game Salamander County Public Television, PLEASE go play their game on Steam! <3
